Message.Name: Quote Short Form Message
Message.Description: Used to disseminate quotation data for NASDAQ listed securities

Message.Name: Quote Long Form Message
Message.Description: Used to disseminate quotation data for NASDAQ listed securities

Message.Name: FINRA ADF Market Participant Quotation Message
Message.Description: For FINRA quotes that do not affect the NBBO or FINRA BBO a FINRA ADF Market Participant Quotation Message will be sent.

Message.Name: CROSS SRO Trading Action Message
Message.Description: This fixed format message will be used to inform subscribers of trading actions – such as halts, pauses, quotation resumptions and trading resumptions

Field.Name: Action Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the action occurred.

Message.Name: Market Center Trading Action Message
Message.Description: This fixed format message will inform UTP data feed subscribers of when a UTP participant invokes or releases a market center-specific trading halt for a NASDAQ-listed security.

Field.Name: Action Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the action occurred.

Message.Name: Regulation SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Used to disseminate quotation data for NASDAQ listed securities

Message.Name: Limit Up Limit Down Price Band Message
Message.Description: Designed to prevent trades in individual NMS Stocks from occurring outside of specified Upper and Lower Limit Price Bands

Message.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Decline Level Message
Message.Description: A Market Wide Circuit Breaker (MWCB) Level message will inform participants and the UTP data recipients what the daily MWCB breach points are set to for the current trading day

Message.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Status Message
Message.Description: A Market Wide Circuit Breaker (MWCB) Status message will inform participants and the UTP data recipients when a MWCB has breached one of the established levels.

Message.Name: Auction Collar Message
Message.Description: Primary markets using an automated reopening will calculate new Auction Collars, in compliance with rules around prices for re-opening, when applicable and publish this new Auction Collar Message

Field.Name: CollarReferencePrice
Field.Description: Reference price used to set collar

Message.Name: Session Close Recap Message
Message.Description: At the request of the market data community, the UTP SIP generates a Session Close Recap message that reflects the National BBO quotation information at the close of the normal market session

Message.Name: Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: The Start of Day control message signifies the beginning of each operational cycle for SIP Processing

Message.Name: End Of Day Message
Message.Description: The End of Day control message signals the end of active message dissemination for the UTP SIP operational cycle

Message.Name: Market Session Open Message
Message.Description: The Market Session Open Control Message signifies the opening of market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: Market Session Close Message
Message.Description: The Session Close Control Message signals the closing of market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: End of Transmissions Message
Message.Description: The End of Transmissions Message signals that there will be no further transmissions of data sent through the UTP SIP line

Message.Name: Quote Wipe Out Message
Message.Description: The Quote Wipe-Out message will be sent to indicate that a UTP Participant is experiencing a problem with their internal systems and, as a result, are not able to update their UTP BBO quotation information

Struct.Name: Message Info
Struct.Description: Outbound data feed messages will precede each message specific data section with a message header

Group.Name: Market Center Close Recap
Group.Description: At the request of the market data community, the UTP SIP generates a Session Close Recap message that reflects the National BBO quotation information at the close of the normal market session
